A gross salary in line with the weight of this expert role. A stylish company car and, if desired, even a charging station at home! Additional net expense allowances. Meal vouchers. Home-working options. 31 days of leave , on top of the statutory public holidays. A position close to management : you work with the CFO on a daily basis and see the impact of your work directly reflected in the decisions of the company. An organisation with prestige, history and unmatched charm. Just that bit different from a post at a company on a business park… An office in Antwerp-Zuid : no barriers, no safety shoes, but style. review_candidates.title: Group Chief Executive Officer
review_candidates.description: The Group CEO will provide overall strategic, commercial and operational leadership for Hazoria Limited, driving sustainable growth, profitability, operational excellence and enterprise value creation across the Company's diversified manufacturing businesses. Hazoria operates across multiple manufacturing segments, including sack, wood, glass, nylon, printing press, marble, UV printing, carton, carpet & rug, defence & metal works and fabrics. The Group CEO will be responsible for translating the Company's investment and growth strategy into measurable business performance across these operations. The successful candidate must have strong private equity / investment-backed company experience, with a demonstrated understanding of how to operate and transform portfolio companies, improve EBITDA, optimise working capital, strengthen governance and deliver measurable value creation. The role requires an executive who can combine strategic thinking, hands-on operational leadership, commercial discipline and investor-level accountability. 1. Business Strategy & Value Creation Develop and execute Hazoria's overall business strategy in alignment with the Group's investment objectives and growth plans. Translate the Company's investment thesis into clear operational and commercial priorities. Develop and drive a comprehensive value creation plan covering revenue growth, margin improvement, cost optimisation, working capital, operational efficiency and capital allocation. Identify opportunities for organic growth, new markets, new products, capacity expansion and strategic partnerships. Regularly assess the performance and strategic relevance of each business line and recommend appropriate interventions. Drive a performance-oriented culture focused on sustainable enterprise value creation. 2. Financial Performance & EBITDA Improvement Take overall accountability for revenue, gross margin, EBITDA, cash generation and working capital performance. Identify and implement initiatives to improve EBITDA and operating margins. Review product, customer and business-line profitability and take corrective action where required. Drive cost optimisation without compromising product quality or business growth. Improve pricing discipline, procurement efficiency, production economics and operating leverage. Ensure financial performance is actively managed rather than reviewed retrospectively. Work closely with Finance to develop accurate budgets, forecasts and financial models. 3. Operational Excellence Provide leadership across Hazoria's manufacturing operations and ensure effective coordination between production, engineering, supply chain, quality, sales and support functions. Improve plant utilisation, production efficiency, yield, productivity and capacity utilisation. Identify and eliminate operational bottlenecks, waste and avoidable costs. Establish appropriate operational performance standards and management routines. Ensure production and operational plans are aligned with commercial demand. Drive continuous improvement initiatives across the Company's manufacturing facilities. Ensure operational risks are identified and appropriately managed. 4. Commercial Growth Develop and execute strategies to grow revenue and market share across Hazoria's business segments. Strengthen customer acquisition, retention and account management. Identify new customer segments, channels and geographic markets. Review the effectiveness of the Company's sales and distribution model. Improve pricing, product mix and customer profitability. Strengthen the Company's competitive positioning across its different product categories. Ensure commercial growth is supported by appropriate production capacity and supply-chain capabilities. 5. Manufacturing & Supply Chain Ensure manufacturing operations are aligned with business and commercial objectives. Monitor production capacity, utilisation, yield, downtime, waste and production costs. Strengthen supply-chain planning, procurement, inventory management and logistics. Improve inventory turns and reduce slow-moving, obsolete and excess inventory. Ensure appropriate supplier performance management and procurement discipline. Identify opportunities for vertical integration, local sourcing and supply-chain optimisation where commercially justified. 6. Capital Allocation & Investment Management Evaluate major capital expenditure requirements and assess their expected commercial and financial returns. Ensure capital is deployed towards initiatives that support strategic priorities and value creation. Review business cases for new equipment, facilities, production lines and expansion projects. Monitor the financial and operational performance of major capital investments. Work with the Group and investment stakeholders on expansion, acquisition and other strategic investment opportunities. Ensure disciplined post-investment performance tracking. 7. Private Equity / Investor Management Serve as a key management interface with the Group's shareholders, investment partners and other stakeholders. Prepare and present business performance updates, value creation progress and strategic initiatives to investors and the Board. Provide clear explanations for performance variances and proposed corrective actions. Maintain a strong understanding of investor expectations, investment horizons and value creation priorities. Support financial, operational and commercial due diligence for potential acquisitions or investments. Support exit-readiness initiatives, including strengthening reporting, governance, operational performance and business sustainability. 8. Performance Management & Management Reporting Establish a robust business performance management system across Hazoria. Ensure management has timely and accurate information for decision-making. Develop appropriate dashboards covering: Revenue, Gross margin, EBITDA, Cash flow, Working capital, Production, Capacity utilisation, Inventory, Sales, Customer performance, Cost efficiency. Conduct regular business performance reviews with functional and business-unit leaders. Hold business leaders accountable for agreed commercial and operational commitments. 9. Governance, Risk & Controls Ensure appropriate governance structures and internal controls are embedded across the business. Work with Finance, Internal Audit, Risk, HSE and other control functions to identify and mitigate key business risks. Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations and Group policies. Promote transparency, accountability and disciplined decision-making. Ensure material business risks are escalated appropriately to the Group and Board. 10. Leadership & Organisation Development Build a high-performing leadership team capable of delivering the Company's growth and value creation agenda. Assess organisational capability and identify critical talent and capability gaps. Develop succession plans for key management positions. Set clear expectations and accountability across the leadership team. Promote collaboration between commercial, operational and support functions. Build a culture of ownership, performance, innovation and continuous improvement. 11. Transformation & Change Management Lead major business transformation and restructuring initiatives where required. Challenge inefficient processes, organisational structures and legacy ways of working. Drive adoption of technology, automation and data-driven decision-making. Lead turnaround initiatives for underperforming business units. Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable financial and operational outcomes. KEY DELIVERABLES The Group CEO will be expected to deliver: Sustainable revenue and EBITDA growth. Improved operating margins and profitability. Increased manufacturing efficiency and capacity utilisation. Improved working capital and cash conversion. Stronger customer and market performance. Improved inventory management. Effective cost optimisation. Disciplined capital allocation. Successful execution of the Company's value creation plan. Strong investor and Board reporting. Improved organisational capability and leadership effectiveness. Increased enterprise value. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Accounting or a related discipline. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification is highly desirable. 12–18 years of progressive leadership experience, with significant experience in manufacturing, industrials, consumer goods or related sectors. Private equity, portfolio-company or investment-backed business experience is mandatory. Demonstrable experience operating within a PE-backed or investor-led environment, preferably in a senior operating or general management capacity. Proven experience in value creation, EBITDA improvement, operational transformation and business performance management. Strong understanding of financial statements, business valuation, cash flow, working capital and capital allocation. Experience managing multi-site or diversified business operations will be highly advantageous. Demonstrated experience working with Boards, shareholders, investors and senior executives. Experience with acquisitions, integrations, restructuring, turnaround or business transformation will be an advantage. Strong commercial and operational leadership experience. CORE COMPETENCIES Private Equity / Portfolio Company Management Value Creation EBITDA & Margin Improvement Strategic Leadership Commercial Growth Operational Excellence Manufacturing Management Financial Acumen Capital Allocation Working Capital Management Business Transformation Investor & Board Management Performance Management Change Management Risk & Governance Leadership & People Management Data-Driven Decision Making Negotiation & Stakeholder Management
